mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_tcc_intent(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,allocation_id,attempt_id,xid,action_name,cell_id, route_epoch,request_digest,request_payload,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{r.enterpriseId},#{r.warehouseId},#{r.allocationId},#{r.attemptId},#{xid},#{action},#{r.cellId}, #{r.routeEpoch},#{digest},#{payload},'REGISTERING',UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory_tcc_intent WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterprise} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouse} AND allocation_id=#{allocation} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_tcc_intent SET branch_id=#{branch},state='REGISTERED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='REGISTERING' AND branch_id IS NULL
UPDATE inventory_tcc_intent SET reservation_id=#{reservation},state='TRIED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND branch_id=#{branch} AND state='REGISTERED'
UPDATE inventory_tcc_intent SET state=#{state},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND branch_id=#{branch} AND state IN ('REGISTERED','TRIED',#{state})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tcc_fence_log WHERE xid=#{xid} AND branch_id=#{branch}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_tcc_terminal(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,xid,branch_id,action_name,terminal_status,proof_json,proof_hash,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{i.id},#{i.enterprise_id},#{i.warehouse_id},#{i.xid},#{i.branch_id},#{i.action_name},#{status},CAST(#{json} AS JSON),#{hash},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.action_name FROM inventory_tcc_terminal t JOIN warehouse_route r ON r.enterprise_id=t.enterprise_id AND r.warehouse_id=t.warehouse_id WHERE r.cell_id=#{cell} AND r.state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.action_name LIMIT 257
